sharedHelperOwnershipFilter.observation: The helper instructions are shared by three call families. Only the two FUN_00DA25D0 call sites supply the lobby ConsumerConnection owner; the other four homologous call contexts are excluded from this field manifest.

lifecycle.observation: The ConsumerConnection constructor calls the ConnectionData constructor, which zeros the field, before installing the derived vtable.
Assignment requires current field zero and candidate setup+0x10 nonzero; it stores the candidate once.
The stored value is passed to the manager slot-3 callback and, when present, one secondary callback. No direct outgoing serialization is present in the traced bodies.
Nonzero is used only as setup-complete state and suppresses retries; no arithmetic, range, equality-to-constant, or uniqueness check uses it.
Reconnect replacement destroys the old object, clears the active pointer, allocates a new object, and therefore reinitializes the new field to zero.
Destruction releases the connection object without reading, serializing, or explicitly clearing the field; object lifetime ends instead.
